chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Muhammad ibn Saif from Mansur ibn Hazim said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who threw [the pebbles] and shaved [his head]: does he eat anything that has a yellowish tint? He said: No, until he performs Tawaf around the House and Sa'i between Safa and Marwah. Then all things become permissible for him except women, until he performs another Tawaf around the House. Then women become permissible for him.
ai.seo_question: What are the rulings on food and marriage after shaving the head before Tawaf in Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahar clarifies the specific rulings for a pilgrim who prematurely shaves his head before completing Tawaf al-Ziyarah, detailing the sequential lifting of prohibitions. While the initial restriction on 'sufrah' (often interpreted as specific foods or garments) is lifted after Sa'i, sexual relations remain prohibited until a second Tawaf is performed, highlighting the distinct legal status of the head-shaving act in Shia jurisprudence. This ruling underscores the importance of completing the Hajj rituals in their prescribed order to fully exit the state of Ihram.
